note: Pilot syntagmatic coding of the 38 real disclosure formulations in data/corpus/corpus.jsonl (corpus stream, branch corpus/collectors, commit 23776ad). Coded by hand by Claude Opus 5 on 2026-09-28 by reading each formulation, then checked against the verbatim text. This is a pilot on a small English corpus of two genres, not a result: it exists to show that the composition of a disclosure can be coded, and what such a coding turns up. Every sequence below can be checked against the item's verbatim text.

move_inventory.HEAD: A heading that names the act itself: 'Declaration of generative AI...', 'STATEMENT ON THE USE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE', 'Acknowledgments'.
move_inventory.FRAME: A temporal or textual frame locating the use: 'During the preparation of this work', 'in the preparation of this manuscript', a date.
move_inventory.ACTOR: A named human subject: 'the authors', 'KIF and JY', 'we', 'I'.
move_inventory.USE: The predicate of use, active or passive: 'used', 'was used', 'was written with the help of', 'generated with'.
move_inventory.TOOL: The tool, named specifically (Grammarly, ChatGPT GPT-5.5, Claude Code) or generically ('AI', 'generative AI technologies').
move_inventory.SCOPE: A quantified share of the artefact: 'Some parts of', 'Many parts of', 'A significant part of', 'most of the code', 'solely'.
move_inventory.PART: The specific part of the artefact at issue, as grammatical subject: 'Figure 1', 'The Python script', 'The patching code'.
move_inventory.PURPOSE: What the tool was used for: 'to check for grammar', 'for language editing', 'for implementation, shader debugging, and refactoring'.
move_inventory.LINK: An explicit link chaining the second clause to the first: 'After using this tool/service'.
move_inventory.CHECK: A human act of checking: 'reviewed and edited the content as needed', 'I have reviewed it', 'were reviewed and modified by a human'.
move_inventory.OBJ: The object of that claim: 'for the content of the publication', 'for the final content'.
move_inventory.NEG: A negative declaration: 'no artificial intelligence was used', 'did not use any generative AI'.
move_inventory.CARVE: A negative carve-out narrowing a positive statement: 'No AI tools were used to generate content, analyze data...'.
move_inventory.COND: A normative condition on the output rather than a report: 'but all outputs must remain maintainable, portable...'.
move_inventory.ASIDE: A stance or affiliation marker: '(sorry purists, haha)'.
move_inventory.POLICY: Present tense, a standing practice rather than a report about this artefact: 'We use AI tools to...'.
move_inventory.CLAIM_OTHER: A claim that is neither checking nor responsibility: 'fully understand all of its output'.

items.sequence: HEAD FRAME ACTOR USE TOOL PURPOSE | LINK ACTOR CHECK RESP OBJ
HEAD FRAME ACTOR USE TOOL SCOPE PURPOSE | LINK ACTOR CHECK RESP OBJ
FRAME ACTOR USE TOOL PURPOSE | LINK ACTOR CHECK RESP OBJ
HEAD FRAME ACTOR USE TOOL PURPOSE
HEAD ACTOR USE PURPOSE | ACTOR NEG
